environment.description: Pod runs with a restrictive securityContext but the key control is the OCI runtime configuration: the container uses a custom seccomp profile (iot-ingester-seccomp-v3.json) that permits open/openat syscalls ONLY when the flags argument does NOT include O_NOFOLLOW being absent — specifically, the profile uses a SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ comparator on the second argument (flags) of openat to DENY calls where (flags & O_NOFOLLOW) == 0 AND the path prefix matches /tmp/. Additionally, PgBouncer is deployed in transaction pooling mode with query_rewrite_enabled and the pgbouncer.ini includes 'disable_raw_sql = 1' and 'prepared_statement_mode = force_generic' which causes all queries to be re-parsed as parameterized statements, stripping inline literals. The pod filesystem uses a read-only overlay for /tmp with a dedicated emptyDir volume at /tmp/iot_spool that has medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 50Mi, meaning symlinks to host paths resolve to nothing (no hostPath mount exists).

config.seccomp_profile: iot-ingester-seccomp-v3.json with SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on openat without O_NOFOLLOW for /tmp/ paths
